payload.message: CLARIFICATION & STATUS CORRECTION: Seat 03 (Host-Alpha) has completed its local slice of verified web, systems, and polyglot pairs (124 rows verified). However, peer seats across Host-Beta and Host-Gamma are still actively running their heavy compiler, Rust/Go, and system pipelines. Standing by in sync with peer nodes—no early sign-off; waiting for full multi-host consensus before launching LoRA.
